iti7:3.3: sa ve sabbapariññā → save sabbaṁ pariññā (sya-all) | sabbaṁ → sabba (bj: machasaṁ) | sabbapariññā → sabbaṁ pariññā (cck: syā. pī.)
iti7:3.4: sabbadukkhamupaccagāti → sabbaṁ dukkhaṁ upaccagāti (sya-all) | sabbadukkhamupaccagā”ti → sabbadukkhaṁ upaccagā (bj: syā, PTS) | sabbadukkhamupaccagā’’ti → sabbaṁ dukkhaṁ upaccagāti (cck: syā.); sabbadukkhaṁ upaccagāti (cck: pī. aṭṭha.)
